comment: P1 gate (TRAILER_V3 §3): World A and World B (the real Planet: its renderer, its matter, two new palettes, city lights on the night side) and MATTER CAM on World A's crust: crack, hold, shear.

shots.comment: The two worlds side by side in the dark at native scale, at half speed: World A (blue and ochre) and World B (violet and teal), city lights breathing on their night sides. The still for the gate.
Wide: the Witness's real Fracture Gaze (scripted signature) strikes World A; the cut into the macro lands on the first crack.

MATTER CAM on the crust where the gaze lands (tight on the crack line, ×24: about 27×15 native pixels, each a big lit tile, tracking the planet): the crack in x0.25, the hold (time pushed through the lull), the shear of the second gaze in x0.25.
